title: Towards Cost-Efficient Video Dataset Construction with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Research on video classification models has witnessed significant growth recently, accompanied by a significant increase in the demand for datasets to train such models. Existing video dataset curation approaches share a common bottleneck: candidate videos must be downloaded before any relevance judgment is made, which results in storage, time and annotation costs. In this work, we present a filtering step, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to pre-screen videos based on their metadata, before actually downloading these videos, thereby saving on these costs. We evaluate the LLMs against a strict human majority vote derived from four independent annotators and validate the reliability of the annotations through inter-annotator agreement analysis (Gwet's AC1). translated_title: 迈向利用大语言模型构建低成本高效的视频数据集
translated_abstract: 近年来，视频分类模型的研究取得了显著增长，随之而来的是对训练此类模型的数据集需求的大幅增加。现有的视频数据集构建方法存在一个共同的瓶颈：在对候选视频进行相关性判断之前必须先下载这些视频，这导致了存储、时间和标注成本。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种过滤步骤，在实际下载视频之前，使用大语言模型（LLM）基于视频的元数据对视频进行预筛选，从而节省这些成本。我们将LLM的判断与由四名独立标注者得出的严格人工多数投票进行对比评估，并通过标注者间一致性分析（Gwet's AC1）验证标注的可靠性。我们将LLM预过滤器与两个不使用LLM的基线方法进行比较，即两种关键词启发式方法。通过留一评估者法（LOO）和加一评估者法（AORI）机制，我们评估了
tldr: 提出利用大语言模型在实际下载前基于视频元数据进行预筛选，从而节省视频数据集构建过程中的存储、时间和标注成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes using Large Language Models to pre-screen videos based on their metadata before downloading, thereby saving storage, time, and annotation costs in video dataset construction.
